# Preamble

```{r}
#| label: preamble

#----------------------------
# clean environment
#----------------------------
rm(list=ls(all=TRUE))
#----------------------------
# source the config file
#----------------------------
library(here)
here()
source(here("R","0-config.R"))
options(knitr.kable.NA = '-')

#----------------------------
# analysis constants
#----------------------------
pathogen_target <- "Shigella/EIEC (IpaB)"
n_expected <- 120
```

# Read in the data

```{r}
#| label: read data

#----------------------------
# Luminex seropositivity data
#----------------------------
d1 <- read_rds(file = here("../../data/bangl/luminex/final/",
                           "washb_bangl_luminex_igg_seropos_pathogen_2026-01-29.rds")) %>%
  # final visit only
  filter(visit == 3) %>%
  # left_join(tx, by = join_by(clusterid)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tr)) %>%
  # Indicatior for WSH and Nutrition interventions
  mutate(wsh = ifelse(tr %in% c("WSH","Nutrition + WSH"), 1, 0), 
         nutr = ifelse(tr %in% c("Nutrition","Nutrition + WSH"), 1, 0),
         wshf = ifelse(wsh==1,"WASH","No WASH"),
         nutrf = ifelse(nutr==1,"Nutrition","No Nutrition"),
         wshf = factor(wshf, levels=c("No WASH","WASH")),
         nutrf = factor(nutrf, levels=c("No Nutrition","Nutrition")))

#----------------------------
# Serimmune substudy metadata
#----------------------------
serimmune <- read_csv(
  here("data", "washb-serimmune-metadata-230616.csv")) 

serimmune_ids <- serimmune %>%
  pull(dataid)
```

# Link Serimmune to the Luminex data
```{r}
#----------------------------
# derive the 5-digit dataid
# from the middle of childid
#----------------------------
dataid_start <- 7   
dataid_stop  <- 11   

d1 <- d1 %>%
  mutate(dataid = str_sub(childid, dataid_start, dataid_stop))


#----------------------------
# restrict d1 to the substudy
#----------------------------
d_sub <- d1 %>%
  filter(dataid %in% serimmune_ids,
         pathogen == "Shigella")
```

## Seroprevalence by arm
```{r}
#| label: descriptive prevalence

prev_sub <- d_sub %>%
  group_by(tr) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(!is.na(seropos)),
            total_seropos = sum(seropos, na.rm = TRUE),
            prev = mean(seropos, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(prev = round(100*prev, 1),
         prev_fmt = paste0(prev, "% (", total_seropos, "/", n, ")"))

prev_sub %>%
  select(tr, prev_fmt) %>%
  kbl(caption = paste0("Luminex seroprevalence, ", pathogen_target,
                       ", Serimmune substudy at 24 months"),
      col.names = c("Arm", "Seroprevalence (n/N)")) %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Times")
```

# WASH+Nutrition vs Control


## Estimate the treatment effect


```{r}
#| label: fit models
d_shig <- d_sub %>%
  mutate(tr = factor(as.character(tr),
                     levels = c("Control","Nutrition + WSH")))
#----------------------------
# helper: fit, cluster-robust vcov,
# marginal means and the contrast
#----------------------------
fit_contrast <- function(dat) {

  # linear-binomial model, identity link,
  # so the coefficient is a risk difference
  fiti <- glm(seropos ~ tr, data = dat, family = gaussian(link = "identity"))

  # cluster-robust SEs at the randomization unit
  fiti_vcovCL <- sandwich::vcovCL(fiti, cluster = dat$clusterid)

  musi  <- emmeans(fiti, ~ tr, vcov = fiti_vcovCL) %>% regrid(type = "response")
  diffi <- pairs(musi, reverse = TRUE)

  means_df <- as.data.frame(musi)
  diff_df  <- as.data.frame(diffi) %>%
    mutate(min95 = estimate - 1.96*SE,
           max95 = estimate + 1.96*SE)

  list(fit = fiti, means = means_df, diff = diff_df)
}

#----------------------------
# unadjusted contrast on all
# children with a non-missing outcome
#----------------------------
d_shig_all <- d_shig %>% filter(!is.na(seropos))

res_unadj <- fit_contrast(d_shig_all)
```

```{r}
#| label: model results table

#------------------------------
# create formatted RD estimates
#------------------------------
model_tbl <- res_unadj$diff %>%
  mutate(
    spec = "Unadjusted",
    n    = nrow(d_shig_all),
    rd   = estimate*100,
    rd_print = paste0(sprintf("%1.1f", estimate*100), " (",
                      sprintf("%1.1f", min95*100), ", ",
                      sprintf("%1.1f", max95*100), ")"),
    p_robust = sprintf("%1.3f", p.value)
  ) %>%
  select(spec, n, rd_print, p_robust)

model_tbl %>%
  kbl(caption = paste0("Risk difference (percentage points), WASH+Nutrition vs Control, ",
                       pathogen_target),
      align = c("l", rep("c", 3)),
      col.names = c("Specification", "N", "RD (95% CI)", "Cluster-robust p")) %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Times") %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, border_right = TRUE, width = "15em") %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "Risk difference on the identity scale, in percentage points, from linear-binomial regression.",
      "Standard errors are cluster-robust at the cluster (randomization unit) level."
    ),
    general_title = "Note: ",
    threeparttable = TRUE
  )
```

# Permutation p-value


```{r}
#| label: permutation test

set.seed(12345)
npermute <- 10006

#----------------------------
# unique cluster / arm
#----------------------------
cl_tx <- d_shig_all %>%
  select(clusterid, tr) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  # group_by(block) %>%
  mutate(tx = as.character(tr))

#----------------------------
# permuted assignments,
#----------------------------
perm_mat <- matrix(nrow = nrow(cl_tx), ncol = npermute)
for (i in 1:npermute) {
  cl_txi <- cl_tx %>% mutate(txi = sample(tx, replace = FALSE))
  perm_mat[,i] <- cl_txi$txi
}

#----------------------------
# observed test statistic:
# regression coefficient from the
# unadjusted linear model
#----------------------------
obs_fit  <- lm(seropos ~ tr, data = d_shig_all)
obs_coef <- coef(obs_fit)[["trNutrition + WSH"]]

#----------------------------
# permutation null distribution
#----------------------------
d_perm <- d_shig_all %>% select(clusterid, seropos)

permute_dist <- foreach(permi = 1:npermute, .combine = rbind) %do% {
  dij <- d_perm %>%
    left_join(data.frame(clusterid = cl_tx$clusterid,
                         tr_perm   = perm_mat[,permi]),
              join_by(clusterid)) %>%
    mutate(tr_perm = factor(tr_perm, levels = c("Control","Nutrition + WSH")))
  fiti <- lm(seropos ~ tr_perm, data = dij)
  data.frame(permute_n = permi, est = coef(fiti)[["tr_permNutrition + WSH"]])
}

p_perm <- mean(abs(permute_dist$est) >= abs(obs_coef), na.rm = TRUE)
```



```{r}
#| label: permutation plot

ggplot(data = permute_dist, aes(x = est)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, alpha = 0.5, color = NA) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = obs_coef, lty = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
           label = paste0("P = ", sprintf("%1.3f", p_perm))) +
  labs(title = paste0("Permutation null, WASH+Nutrition vs Control: ", pathogen_target),
       x = "permutation null distribution (WASH+N - Control)",
       y = "permutations") +
  theme_minimal()

```
